resources.string: Lets the mouse and keyboard of your computer control this phone: shows a pointer, turns clicks into taps and types text. One Cursor only acts on input sent by the computer you connect to.
One Cursor needs its accessibility service to show the pointer and turn clicks and key presses into touches and text.
The cursor is on this phone
Move the mouse past the screen edge to come here
Must match a screen name in the server\'s layout.
Barrier and One Cursor servers use TLS by default.
Searching… (Barrier servers must be entered by hand)
Type Vietnamese with the computer keyboard (aa → â, s → sắc, …).
Text copied on the computer is put on this phone\'s clipboard automatically.
Send the phone\'s clipboard when the cursor leaves
Briefly opens an invisible screen, because Android only lets the focused app read the clipboard.
%1$s presented this certificate fingerprint (SHA-256). Check that it matches the one shown on the server before trusting it.

1. Run One Cursor (or Barrier / Input Leap) as a server on your computer.
2. Add this phone's screen name to the server's layout, e.g. to the right of the computer.
3. Enable the accessibility service, enter the server address and connect.

Left click = tap, hold = long press, drag = swipe, wheel = scroll. Esc = Back, Cmd/Ctrl+Space = notifications.
